mobbin:51398a50-ab88-4cb6-8d7d-08e18e411.summary: Lock-screen Live Activity shows a Rest countdown with dismiss, then a Study countdown with progress bar, then a completed-focus summary with restart and today’s total.
steps: Lock screen Live Activity: Rest + X
Lock screen Live Activity: Study + progress
steal: Rest: large remaining time + phase label + one X control without unlocking.
Study: same chrome adds a thin progress bar under the phase label.
Done: outcome copy, start–end clock range, restart glyph, and daily total on the lock screen.
avoid: Depends on native Live Activities—clashes with preferred web debrief/client and phone-ban exams; treat as native-only pattern, not the primary MVP surface.
mobbin:51398a50-ab88-4cb6-8d7d-08e18e411.fit: Mobile uniquely surfaces phase time on the lock screen (desktop/SRV cannot); strong argument that timer job benefits from phone—extend room timers with always-visible remaining time for faculty holding devices between tasks.

mobbin:3ff1275c-8826-4b99-b53c-abb5a3c45.summary: Dynamic Island shows a compact sprout + countdown while the app is backgrounded, then expands to countdown, Rest phase label, and an X stop control.
steal: Compact: persistent remaining time in the system chrome while elsewhere in the OS.
Expanded: phase label under time plus single X to end without opening the app.
avoid: iPhone Dynamic Island only—useless on generic tablets/web and during phone-banned summative exams; do not require it.
mobbin:3ff1275c-8826-4b99-b53c-abb5a3c45.fit: Shows why mobile (not SRV) can keep a session timer glanceable during other work; for Essentials prefer lock-screen/widget-like always-on timer where OS allows, with a large in-app fallback for web/tablet.
